headline: One platform. Every school operation.
subheadline: Daily operations, multi-school view, configuration, marketplace, migration, and analytics — built to work the way schools actually run.

segments.title: Daily operations
segments.body: Run every part of school operations: admissions, academics, attendance, finance, communication, workflows, reports, Student 360.

segments.title: Multi-school view
segments.body: Govern schools, districts, and networks from one command center. Policies, health, usage.

segments.title: Configured for your school
segments.body: One platform core, configured for your institution. Country, language, branding, workflow and dashboard packs.

segments.title: Marketplace
segments.body: Apps, integrations, workflow packs, dashboard packs, blueprint packs, templates.

segments.title: Migration
segments.body: Import, map, validate, and switch from legacy systems safely.

segments.title: Analytics & Integrations
segments.body: School and district analytics, health scores, payments, messaging, SSO, APIs, webhooks.
